limitations.workflow: Post a document without Accounting, OperationalRegisters or ReferenceRegisters handlers
limitations.decision: Preserve the public SDK lifecycle. Standard Post requires a registered handler, but that handler may intentionally produce no movements. Successful posting with empty effects and rejection of a missing handler are separate cases; no SDK change is required to support the former.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Inventing register movements solely to permit a lifecycle transition

limitations.workflow: Return a completed document action result only to a currently authorized actor
limitations.observedError: Earlier 3.4.0 candidates returned HTTP 200 on replay by an actor whose document GET returned HTTP 403.
limitations.decision: Corrected before 3.4.0 publication: completed replay refreshes current permissions, requires source View and action authorization, evaluates custom authorization with current facts, and checks View of any created document. It preserves the stored result without rerunning handlers, availability or expected-version checks. Keep the original denial regressions mandatory and preserve historical candidate failures. These fixtures supplied the original request and key; practical exploitability was not established.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Treating a known idempotency key as authorization
Skipping the denied-replay regression or accepting HTTP 200 as its expected outcome
Changing document lifecycle or adding controller-specific bypasses to conceal the defect

limitations.workflow: Include built-in General Journal Entry in generic installed-definition document search
limitations.observedError: Generic lookup requires a display column absent from the built-in journal metadata; search returns documents in UnavailableSources with Truncated=true.
limitations.decision: Preserve the existing SDK. Use scoped application-document search or the existing typed General Journal Entry endpoint, and expose source-unavailable information for incomplete generic results. This task does not change built-in metadata or storage.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Adding an invented display field to the built-in journal metadata or database
Suppressing UnavailableSources or claiming exhaustive document results

limitations.workflow: Read built-in General Journal Entry detail metadata or record through MCP
limitations.observedError: ngb_get_metadata, ngb_get_record and compatibility fetch return internal_error because generic document metadata requires a display column absent from the built-in journal.
limitations.decision: Preserve the existing SDK. MCP discovery and the typed journal list remain usable. Use the existing authorized /api/accounting/general-journal-entries/{id} API for detail reads. The separately asserted direct metadata failure ties this limitation to the existing generic display-column requirement.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Adding a display field to SDK metadata or storage solely to satisfy MCP
Advertising a failed detail read as supported

limitations.workflow: Execute a PostgreSQL composable report with malformed from_utc or to_utc date text
limitations.observedError: The provider raises ngb.configuration.violation and the standard HTTP boundary returns 500 rather than a validation response of 400.
limitations.decision: Preserve the existing SDK and document this error mapping separately from supported request-validation checks. Supply ISO yyyy-MM-dd dates. An application requirement for a 400 response to malformed date text needs its own explicit validation boundary; date metadata alone does not provide it.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Claiming that date metadata guarantees a 400 response for malformed text
Mapping all configuration failures to validation failures
Changing the SDK within AI Development Kit work

limitations.workflow: Start exact-date operational-register history with GetByOccurredAtCursorAsync and a null cursor
limitations.observedError: The default PostgreSQL provider returns SQLSTATE 42P08 (could not determine data type of parameter) for the first null-cursor request against an existing movements table.
limitations.decision: Preserve SDK behavior. Start with a bounded GetByOccurredAtPageAsync request and continue from its last displayed row with a non-null occurrence/time-ID cursor. Do not advertise null-cursor startup as supported by this provider.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Changing provider SQL or parameter binding within AI Development Kit work
Inventing a sentinel cursor before all possible records
Suppressing the failure or claiming that the null-cursor first page succeeds
